verdict: No actionable durable-data, concurrency or account-safety finding was identified in the frozen minimal repair and its authored native regressions. This is source review only.
reported_physical_error: A practice set references a missing passage.
cause_trace: Queue draining receives a stale sets or practice_sessions upsert rejection and requests adoption of the complete remote practice ledger.
That adoption happens before syncAll reaches its ordinary metadata pull.
A remote practice set can therefore reference a new passage absent from the local library.
PracticeStore validation correctly rejects the incomplete ledger; drain retains the stale queued write and cannot reach the later metadata pull needed to resolve it.
repair_review: SyncEngine.pullPracticeSnapshot fetches sessions, sets and attempts, then awaits optional dependency preparation before synchronous practice publication or practice cursor acknowledgement.
After preparation, engine generation and cancellation are checked before publication. Coordinator callbacks also check the captured account owner before and after awaited metadata work.
Missing score/passage dependencies, historical snapshot ancestry and insufficient score metadata trigger instruments, tags, atomic folders, atomic pieces/page_edits and atomic passages in that order.
Existing validated LWW merges and score-replacement safeguards are reused; validation is not weakened and missing references are not dropped.
Practice LWW decisions use current local clocks after dependency preparation; the existing practice merge unions attempts and retains local Undo.
Drain acknowledges its captured queue prefix only after successful practice adoption, leaving concurrently appended local progress pending.

authored_regressions_reviewed.assertions: Control reproduces the exact prior error; repaired path adopts the missing passage and remote history, acknowledges the original queued write, retains local active state and Undo, and preserves newer local score/passage edits.
Metadata failure retains original queue bytes, practice cursors and local practice state; a later retry can recover.
Account invalidation during a suspended passage fetch prevents practice adoption and acknowledgement while retaining queued writes.
New local repetition and Undo survive suspended hydration; only the original captured queue prefix is acknowledged and the appended progress tail remains exact.
